overview: The Medford Charter Study Committee received a presentation from the Collins Center on modern charter structures and discussed strategies for public engagement.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Collins Center Presentation on Charter Framework
items.summary: Representatives from the Collins Center presented a modern model charter outline and answered committee questions regarding state general laws, charter amendments, and municipal precedents.

items.title: Public Engagement Strategies
items.summary: The committee discussed strategies for community outreach, agreeing to prioritize drafting an educational flyer and planning future public forums and surveys.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Human Rights Commission Chair Chelli Keshavan urged the committee to ensure community input meaningfully impacts charter design, particularly for underrepresented populations.
